_comment: Curated open-license organization/management theory corpus for APD. Each entry ingests as one `book` source. `access` is 'public' because every title here is public-domain or openly (CC) licensed and therefore redistributable; `license` records the exact terms (attribution is carried into the DB via `citation`). `fetch` describes how scripts/ingest-books.ts obtains the text: 'gutenberg-txt' | 'html' | 'text' = downloaded + converted by the script from `url`; 'manual' = source the script cannot fetch headlessly (PDF behind a converter, or a site that blocks non-browser clients), so produce books/<id>.md out-of-band first (see each entry's `note`) and run the ingest with --no-fetch. NOTE (2026-06): the original landing-page URLs for the OpenStax/Pressbooks/ScholarWorks titles were JS-gated, removed, or WAF-challenged and could not be fetched headlessly; entries now point at the verified ungated sources actually used, with the exact obtain method in `note`. Follett's 'Creative Experience' was removed from the corpus — its only available sources are scanned OCR (Internet Archive djvu/PDF) which produced unusable section structure; re-add only if a born-digital edition appears.

books.title: The Principles of Scientific Management
books.author: Frederick Winslow Taylor
books.citation: Taylor, F. W. (1911). The Principles of Scientific Management. Harper & Brothers. Public domain.

books.title: The New State: Group Organization the Solution of Popular Government
books.author: Mary Parker Follett
books.citation: Follett, M. P. (1918). The New State: Group Organization the Solution of Popular Government. Longmans, Green and Co. Public domain.

books.title: Organizational Behavior
books.author: J. Stewart Black; David S. Bright; Donald G. Gardner; et al.
books.citation: Black, J. S., Bright, D. S., & Gardner, D. G., et al. (2019). Organizational Behavior. OpenStax, Rice University. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.
books.note: Verified ungated text-PDF on Internet Archive (item: openstax-organizational-behavior — NOT the cnx-org-col30687 'derived copy'). curl the url to a local .pdf, then `python scripts/book-pdf-to-md.py <that.pdf> openstax-organizational-behavior` (font-size heading extraction) -> books/<id>.md, then `npm run books:ingest-all -- --no-fetch --only openstax-organizational-behavior`. The openstax.org details page is JS-gated and cannot be fetched headlessly.

books.title: Principles of Management
books.author: David S. Bright; Anastasia H. Cortes; et al.
books.citation: Bright, D. S., & Cortes, A. H., et al. (2019). Principles of Management. OpenStax, Rice University. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.
books.note: Verified ungated text-PDF on Internet Archive (item: PrinciplesofManagement). curl the url to a local .pdf, then `python scripts/book-pdf-to-md.py <that.pdf> openstax-principles-of-management` -> books/<id>.md -> ingest --no-fetch. The openstax.org details page is JS-gated.

books.title: Organizational Behavior
books.author: Talya Bauer; Berrin Erdogan
books.citation: Bauer, T., & Erdogan, B. (2010). Organizational Behavior. Flat World Knowledge (Saylor/UMN). Licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0.
books.note: Identity verified from the PDF's own title/copyright page (Flat World Knowledge, code fwk-28776, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0) — NOT the OpenStax book of the same title. The original open.lib.umn.edu copy was removed from its collection. This url is an ungated LMS-hosted PDF that may rotate; cache books/<id>.md so re-ingest does not depend on it. Archive.org has only borrow-gated scans + an HTML-in-zip (no direct PDF). curl the url to a local .pdf, then `python scripts/book-pdf-to-md.py <that.pdf> bauer-erdogan-organizational-behavior` -> books/<id>.md -> ingest --no-fetch. NonCommercial license.

books.title: Public Administration: The Essentials
books.author: Jayme L. Renfro
books.citation: Renfro, J. L. (2023). Public Administration: The Essentials. University of Northern Iowa. Licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
books.note: Publisher PDF (scholarworks.uni.edu viewcontent.cgi) is behind an AWS WAF JS-challenge — uncurlable. Instead extract the born-digital reader text from this UMN Manifold project via its open JSON API + per-section HTML: run `node scripts/fetch-renfro-manifold.mjs` (enumerates texts -> /api/v1/texts/:id/relationships/text_sections -> fetches /read/<textSlug>/section/<id> -> extracts <div id=manifold-text-section>). Cleaner than the PDF would have been (no OCR). Writes books/renfro-public-administration-essentials.md (~86k words, 11 sections); then ingest --no-fetch. NonCommercial license.
